headline: Nigerian government clears N1.23 trillion legacy debt owed to power generation companies
summary: President Bola Tinubu's administration has paid N1.23 trillion in accumulated legacy debts to Nigerian power generating companies to improve cash flow and electricity stability.
why: Power sector illiquidity and unpaid legacy debts have long constrained generation capacity and grid reliability in Nigeria.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Clearing government debts to power producers injects liquidity into Nigeria's energy sector.
